footer.tagline: Answers from the humanitarian record, with the source attached.

hero.lede: Ask about any crisis, generate M&E situation and technical reports, and see the indicators behind them. Every claim links to the report it came from.

flows.title: From a quick question to the brief you hand in.
flows.lede: Chat for the latest state of a crisis, reports that synthesise many sources at once, and technical monitoring with the statistics done in code.

chat.title: Cited chat
chat.lede: Answers only from retrieved reports, each claim one click from its source.

report.title: M&E reports
report.lede: Pick a country, sector, period and language; get a structured, cited brief.

tech.title: Technical monitoring
tech.lede: Indicator trends and regional comparisons, tested in code, narrated by the model.
tech.head: {country} · Technical monitoring · Refugees

decreasing.significant: From its {peak} peak to {end}, the number of Syrian refugees abroad shows a significant decreasing trend (p {p}).
decreasing.notSignificant: From its {peak} peak to {end}, the number of Syrian refugees abroad shows a decreasing trend that is not statistically significant (p {p}).

increasing.significant: From its {peak} peak to {end}, the number of Syrian refugees abroad shows a significant increasing trend (p {p}).
increasing.notSignificant: From its {peak} peak to {end}, the number of Syrian refugees abroad shows an increasing trend that is not statistically significant (p {p}).

trend.none: From its {peak} peak to {end}, the number of Syrian refugees abroad shows no clear trend (p {p}).

dash.title: See the indicators behind every report.
dash.lede: A country view built from the same data the technical reports use, with its source on every figure.
dash.label: Sample dashboard · data: HDX HAPI
dash.bars: Syrian refugees by host country, top 5 · {year}
dash.foot: Preview built from real HDX HAPI figures for Syria; the dashboard feature itself is planned.

coverage.title: Built on the last year of ReliefWeb.
coverage.lede: Every answer and report draws on the same index, so you can see how much record stands behind it.
coverage.caption: Each dot is a country, sized by its indexed reports.

audiences.title: For people who have to cite what they write.

me.title: Monitoring & evaluation teams
me.body: Track a country or sector over time, pull the evidence behind each finding, and turn it into a cited situation brief for your next report.

orgs.title: Humanitarian organizations
orgs.body: Get a sourced picture of a crisis before the coordination meeting, without opening every PDF first.

research.title: Researchers & analysts
research.body: Trace trends across countries and time, with citations ready to drop into your own analysis.

press.title: Journalists
press.body: Check what agencies on the ground actually reported, and open the original report in one click.

closing.title: Spend your time on the evidence.
closing.body: Ask your first question free, or generate a situation report for the country you're tracking.
